punchline: A man with a watch told Schmidt when to walk and when to sit.
thirty_sec: In Taylor's own account of Bethlehem Steel, one man out of seventy-five was picked, paid $1.85 instead of $1.15, and told by a man with a watch when to walk and when to rest; he loaded 47.5 tons instead of the gang's 12.5.
question: When did you last ask the person who does a task every day how they would set its pace, before you set it yourself?
key_contrast: The one who measures versus the one who knows.
